core_obligations: Reduce to a single sheaf (proof lines 8102-8112): represent K by a bounded below complex F^bullet; the case of a sheaf gives F^n = a_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F^n with R^q a_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F^n = 0 for q > 0, so Leray's acyclicity lemma applied to a_X^{-1}F^bullet and a_{X,*} concludes; hence assume K = F a sheaf.
Reformulate (proof lines 8114-8117): by the description of the pullback along pi_X one has a_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F = F, so it remains to prove R^q a_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F = 0 for q > 0.

Degenerate the Leray spectral sequence (proof lines 8118-8125): write a_X = epsilon_X o pi_X and use the relative Leray spectral sequence; the V-C statement gives R^i epsilon_{X,*}(a_X^{-1}F) = 0 for i > 0 with epsilon_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F = pi_X^{-1}F, and the collected Zariski properties give R^j pi_{X,*}(pi_X^{-1}F) = 0 for j > 0; hence all higher direct images of a_X on a_X^{-1}F vanish.
proof_roadmap: Use Leray's acyclicity lemma to reduce from a bounded below complex to a single sheaf.
Replace a_{X,*}a_X^{-1}F by F using the description of the pullback along pi_X.
Degenerate the relative Leray spectral sequence with the two vanishing inputs for epsilon_X and pi_X.
difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes cohomological descent for the comparison between the qc and topological realisations of a locally quasi-compact space (statement lines 8092-8099). The proof (proof lines 8101-8125) reduces to a single sheaf by Leray's acyclicity lemma, uses the description of the pullback along pi_X to rewrite the composite, and degenerates the relative Leray spectral sequence using the vanishing for the two factors epsilon_X and pi_X. H2: one reduction plus one spectral-sequence degeneration, written out.
